text.text_excerpt: One of the best meals I've had in New Orleans, and in my life! Everything about this place was done perfectly and professionally. Doris Metropolitan is an upscale steakhouse in the French Quarter. Sure, on the surface that would generally make it a place I wouldn't want to go. Namely because both steakhouses and restaurants in the french quarter have - by large - become very generic amalgams of what most people want. Many of these establishments are capable of providing a good meal, but with every little in terms of originality, distinction, and memorability. Doris is different. Doris Metropolitan was my other favorite restaurant from our recent NOLA trip. Their steaks were TO DIE FOR. The 21 day aged ribeye was one of the best steaks I've ever had. They definitely are huge so if you want to really indulge in appetizers and dessert you might want to share the steak (or not if you're selfish when it comes to great steaks like me!) because it's a lot of food. The service was also amazing and set the standard for our entire trip. Although all the restaurants we went to had great service, Doris was still the best. DORIS I love new experiences. Being able to walk into a new space and not knowing what to expect is exciting for me. Especially, if the event, place, etc. exceeds your expectations. Doris, @dorismetropolitan did just that and more. This had to be one of the best dinners I've had in the city thus far. The ambiance was relaxing, the service was marvelous and those beautiful steaks were impeccable. This restaurant is perfect for date night, any celebration, holiday or anniversary. We made reservations for 7pm. Of course you all know by now, I ran a few minutes late. I just can't seem to get there on time. They were very understanding and had our table ready.
